videos.title: Course Introduction
videos.outline: The course introduction: why medical records matter, what the 12 modules cover and how they fit together, who the course is for and what learners will be able to do. Overview only; each module is its own set of videos.

videos.title: Purpose Ownership and Law, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 1. Cover ONLY sections 1.1–1.6: 1.1 What a medical record actually is; 1.2 The six jobs the record has to do; 1.3 What counts as part of the record, and what does not; 1.4 Who owns the file and who owns the information; 1.5 The legal framework in India; 1.6 The three-year rule and the seventy-two hour rule. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Purpose Ownership and Law, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 1. Cover ONLY sections 1.7–1.14: 1.7 The record as evidence; 1.8 Electronic records and admissibility; 1.9 NABH 6th Edition: which standards the file is tested against; 1.10 The four currencies of poor documentation; 1.11 Who writes what: the responsibility map; 1.12 The record review process; 1.13 Myths that cause real damage; 1.14 What good looks like. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Structure and Contents, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 2. Cover ONLY sections 2.1–2.6: 2.1 Why structure matters more than it appears to; 2.2 The standard assembly order; 2.3 The mandatory contents of an inpatient record; 2.4 What goes on every page and against every entry; 2.5 Outpatient, emergency and day-care records; 2.6 Forms control. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Structure and Contents, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 2. Cover ONLY sections 2.7–2.14: 2.7 The file jacket and the index; 2.8 The deficiency checklist; 2.9 Paper, electronic and the hybrid trap; 2.10 Designing a form that gets completed; 2.11 Specialty record sets; 2.12 Loose sheets and how documents are lost; 2.13 Registration: where the record begins; 2.14 The ward check before a file leaves. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Documentation Principles, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 3. Cover ONLY sections 3.1–3.5: 3.1 The ten principles; 3.2 Legibility and the cost of handwriting; 3.3 Correcting an error; 3.4 Late entries, addenda and amendments; 3.5 Abbreviations. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Documentation Principles, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 3. Cover ONLY sections 3.6–3.14: 3.6 Verbal instructions, countersignature and supervision; 3.7 Blank spaces, unused fields and the pre-signed form; 3.8 Where documentation predictably fails; 3.9 Self-check before you close an entry; 3.10 Language, interpreters and the record; 3.11 Dates, times and numbers; 3.12 Students, non-registered staff and who may write; 3.13 Writing when you disagree; 3.14 The physical and electronic security of what you write. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Clinical Notes in Practice, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 4. Cover ONLY sections 4.1–4.5: 4.1 The first twenty-four hours; 4.2 The initial nursing assessment and risk screens; 4.3 The progress note; 4.4 Frequency and reassessment; 4.5 The nursing record set. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Clinical Notes in Practice, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 4. Cover ONLY sections 4.6–4.14: 4.6 Documenting escalation; 4.7 Handover and transfer; 4.8 Documenting what the patient was told; 4.9 Pain documentation; 4.10 Restraint documentation; 4.11 Vulnerable patients; 4.12 Allied health documentation; 4.13 Family communication; 4.14 Putting this module to work. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Medication and Orders, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 5. Cover ONLY sections 5.1–5.5: 5.1 The anatomy of a medication order; 5.2 Allergy documentation; 5.3 Verbal and telephone orders; 5.4 High-alert and look-alike sound-alike medications; 5.5 Administration, omission and refusal. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Medication and Orders, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 5. Cover ONLY sections 5.6–5.14: 5.6 Medication reconciliation; 5.7 Blood and blood products; 5.8 Adverse drug reactions and medication errors; 5.9 Controlled substances; 5.10 Infusions and titrated therapy; 5.11 Chemotherapy documentation; 5.12 Antimicrobial documentation and stewardship; 5.13 The discharge prescription and counselling; 5.14 Medication documentation in special situations. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Consent Documentation, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 6. Cover ONLY sections 6.1–6.6: 6.1 What consent is, and what the form is; 6.2 Capacity; 6.3 Information: how much must be disclosed; 6.4 Who may give consent; 6.5 When consent is taken, and by whom; 6.6 Consents with their own legal rules. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Consent Documentation, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 6. Cover ONLY sections 6.7–6.14: 6.7 Documenting refusal; 6.8 Consent in an electronic record; 6.9 Auditing consent; 6.10 Consent for anaesthesia; 6.11 Withdrawal of consent; 6.12 Consent, trainees and who operates; 6.13 Research consent; 6.14 Photography, recording and teaching. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Investigations and Operative Records, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 7. Cover ONLY sections 7.1–7.5: 7.1 Ordering an investigation; 7.2 Receiving and acting on results; 7.3 The perioperative paper trail; 7.4 The operative note; 7.5 Implants and prostheses. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Investigations and Operative Records, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 7. Cover ONLY sections 7.6–7.14: 7.6 Anaesthesia and sedation records; 7.7 The recovery record; 7.8 Procedures outside the operating theatre; 7.9 Specimens and the histopathology chain; 7.10 The surgical safety checklist as a record; 7.11 Imaging requests and reports; 7.12 Point-of-care testing; 7.13 Sample rejection and repeat testing; 7.14 Theatre registers and the count. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Discharge Transfer and Death, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 8. Cover ONLY sections 8.1–8.7: 8.1 Why the discharge summary carries disproportionate weight; 8.2 Writing each section properly; 8.3 Pending results at discharge; 8.4 The five exit routes; 8.5 Discharge against medical advice; 8.6 Transfer to another hospital; 8.7 Absconding. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Discharge Transfer and Death, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 8. Cover ONLY sections 8.8–8.14: 8.8 Documenting a death; 8.9 Medico-legal deaths; 8.10 Body handover; 8.11 End-of-life documentation; 8.12 The discharge process and who does what; 8.13 Writing for the reader who will actually use it; 8.14 Readmission and what the summary should have prevented. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Coding and Classification, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 9. Cover ONLY sections 9.1–9.5: 9.1 From bedside to bill; 9.2 Reading a code; 9.3 The four diagnosis types; 9.4 The phrases that make a record uncodeable; 9.5 The clinician query. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Coding and Classification, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 9. Cover ONLY sections 9.6–9.14: 9.6 Under-coding, over-coding and up-coding; 9.7 Clinical documentation improvement; 9.8 Coding and the insurance claim; 9.9 Coding ethics; 9.10 Hospital statistics derived from the record; 9.11 Statutory and registry reporting; 9.12 Coding quality and productivity; 9.13 Package-based schemes and the documentation they require; 9.14 Terminology, synonyms and why precision matters. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: MRD Operations, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 10. Cover ONLY sections 10.1–10.5: 10.1 The record’s journey; 10.2 Numbering systems; 10.3 Filing; 10.4 Issue, tracking and retrieval; 10.5 Deficiency analysis and the chase. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: MRD Operations, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 10. Cover ONLY sections 10.6–10.14: 10.6 Retention; 10.7 Destruction; 10.8 Staffing, security and the physical department; 10.9 Measuring the department; 10.10 Space, growth and planning; 10.11 Scanning and digitisation projects; 10.12 Records in a disaster; 10.13 Multi-site hospitals and outsourced services; 10.14 The records policy manual. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Confidentiality Access and Medico Legal, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 11. Cover ONLY sections 11.1–11.6: 11.1 The basis of the duty; 11.2 Who may be given the record; 11.3 The release-of-information workflow; 11.4 Police requests; 11.5 Court summons and giving evidence; 11.6 Categories with stricter rules. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: Confidentiality Access and Medico Legal, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 11. Cover ONLY sections 11.7–11.14: 11.7 Medico-legal cases; 11.8 Data breaches; 11.9 Privacy in the physical environment; 11.10 Telephone and electronic enquiries; 11.11 Staff, social media and curiosity; 11.12 High-profile and sensitive admissions; 11.13 Research access to records; 11.14 Responding to a complaint about confidentiality. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: EMR Audit and Governance, Part 1
videos.outline: Part 1 of 2 of module 12. Cover ONLY sections 12.1–12.6: 12.1 The failure modes paper never had; 12.2 What makes an electronic record trustworthy; 12.3 Downtime; 12.4 Interoperability and national standards; 12.5 The documentation audit; 12.6 Indicators. The other half of the module is a separate video.

videos.title: EMR Audit and Governance, Part 2
videos.outline: Part 2 of 2 of module 12. Cover ONLY sections 12.7–12.14: 12.7 Governance; 12.8 Building a documentation improvement programme; 12.9 Where this course has taken you; 12.10 Configuring an electronic record for documentation quality; 12.11 Scribes, dictation and voice recognition; 12.12 Competency and training; 12.13 Preparing the documentation evidence pack; 12.14 A ninety-day improvement plan. The other half of the module is a separate video.
